lines: His role has shrunk lately: he played 55% of snaps over his last 3 games, down from 63% on the season, and averaged 3.3 targets per game.
Even with that, he's averaging 9.9 PPR points per game this season and has scored 6 touchdowns.
Week 12 is vs DEN, which allows the 3rd-most PPR points per game to tight ends. PIT's implied team total is 17.8 points.
